intent: Build Glassbox 02 - The Feed Dial as a six-minute scrollytelling explorable in the LEARN pillar: tune the ranking weights behind Bea's feed, watch 35 days of supply drift, then discover that capping conflict makes room while paying for context changes what fills it. Point back to the Five Weeks anchor.
scope: src/games/glassbox/feed-model.ts - three-genre supply adaptation, cap, context payment, cap-to-halve calculation
src/games/glassbox/feed-model.test.ts - eight model and edge-case tests
src/games/glassbox/feed-stages.tsx - lineup, dial, 35-day chart, and cap sheets
src/games/glassbox/TheFeedDial.tsx - four-section scrollytelling narrative and model disclosure
src/games/glassbox/scrolly.tsx - shared primitives reused; stale comments corrected
src/games/glassbox/catalog.ts - Glassbox 02 entry with feed preview
src/app/pages/Hub.tsx - feed preview on the 02 feature card
src/index.css - paper feed instruments, responsive compaction, reduced-motion rules
scripts/feed-dial-smoke.mjs - hub, scroll, model, responsive, a11y, and layout checks
scripts/glassbox-smoke.mjs - hub locator updated for two Glassbox cards
docs/GLASSBOX.md, docs/GAMES.md, docs/design-system.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/VISION.md - design and status records
constraints: Depict deception, never enable it: no real targets, channels, scripts, tools, platforms, or live scam templates.
Fictional people, sources, handles, and figures; all rates are labeled illustrative and the piece is explicitly not a forecast.
No new dependency and no new external asset.
Scroll is emphasis, never disclosure: every step stays in the DOM in reading order.
Mobile-first, keyboard-playable, screen-reader labeled, reduced-motion safe, no color-only meaning, 11px minimum text, 44px controls.
Local-first: no accounts, no tracking, no server data.
Do not commit, push, or deploy without explicit authorization.
acceptance_checks: Hub shows a The Feed Dial card with a week-five conflict preview; direct route and hub fallback both work.
Sections #feed, #dial, #weeks, and #cap each pin a paper stage and activate all four steps at 390px, 320x568, and 1440x900.
Default week one is 44% conflict; week five is 67% conflict, 13% context, 11 clicks/day; the chart has 35 bars.
Changing the conflict weight moves the week-five projection (82% at 3x, 27% at 0x) and restoring 2x returns 67%.

Cap at 100% alone yields 27% conflict / 29% context / 8 clicks with novelty leading; adding context payment yields 22% conflict / 40% context / 7.3 clicks with context leading; the cap marker moves left (81% -> 75%).
Payment alone at cap 0 leaves conflict at 62% vs 20% context, demonstrating that making room and paying for context are separate levers.
No horizontal overflow at 390, 320x568, or 1440; pinned sheets fit at both mobile sizes and the desktop stage sticks at y=72.
Reduced motion: rail absent, reveals at opacity 1 and transform none, all interactions still work.
Zero console/page errors; axe 0 serious/critical on hub and piece.
npm test, npm run build, feed-dial smoke, and the Glassbox 01 smoke all pass.
next_action: User review of The Feed Dial on phone and desktop. No commit, push, or deploy has been made. On approval, choose the next Glassbox piece (Tell Decay, artifact-generation economics, or the liar's dividend).

review.mode: self-review by the author; independent ./meos review unavailable (codex CLI not installed)
